component.name: Airdrop Linux
component.summary: Share files and clipboard across your devices

description.p: Share files and clipboard text through a local workspace with a desktop companion and a web app for your other devices.

ul.li: Add files individually or combine them into a ZIP archive
Browse shared files, organize folders and restore items from the workspace trash
Share clipboard text and save clipboard images as files

description.p: Local files and clipboard work without Tailscale. Connect other devices through app-managed Tailscale or explicit trusted-LAN sharing. Tailscale mode requires signing in through your browser, the same tailnet on the other device, and tailnet HTTPS certificates. LAN mode uses unencrypted HTTP and a private pairing link. No host VPN daemon or terminal setup is required.
Background sharing requires desktop portal permission. Without permission, sharing stops when the window closes. Choose Stop sharing and quit to stop the bundled server.
